import os
import time
import uuid

import pytest
import requests

from notifier import email

RECIPIENT = "receipts@sink.acme.test"
POLL_TIMEOUT_S = 30
POLL_INTERVAL_S = 2

pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
    not (os.environ.get("MAIL_API_KEY") and os.environ.get("SINK_INBOX_URL")),
    reason="MAIL_API_KEY and SINK_INBOX_URL are required for sandbox integration tests",
)


def _find_message(message_id):
    resp = requests.get(
        os.environ["SINK_INBOX_URL"],
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['MAIL_API_KEY']}"},
        timeout=10,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    for msg in resp.json():
        if msg.get("id") == message_id:
            return msg
    return None


def test_send_receipt_is_delivered_to_sandbox_sink():
    invoice_id = f"inv_it_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    message_id = email.send_receipt(invoice_id, RECIPIENT, 1200)
    assert message_id

    deadline = time.monotonic() + POLL_TIMEOUT_S
    msg = None
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        msg = _find_message(message_id)
        if msg:
            break
        time.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_S)

    assert msg is not None, f"message {message_id} was not delivered to the sink inbox"
    assert msg["subject"] == "Your receipt"
    assert invoice_id in msg["html"]
